text:
Priya Nair: Quick heads up: EU marketplace reviewer wants evidence bundle for our joint listing with EdgeForge. They specifically asked for (1) SOC2 control summary, (2) pen-test report excerpt + remediation timeline, and (3) HSM key-attestation for the edge appliance.
Ben Lowe: Thanks. Is the pen-test ask for the full report or a redacted executive summary? Last time we provided an exec summary + vuln triage CSV.
Marco Diaz: Reviewer said they need a notarized witness statement for penetration testing if a third party 'witnessed' the test. EdgeForge's SI did a remote pen w/ witness logs. They want witness contact + signed statement.
evidence-bot: Created draft manifest: items -> soc2-summary-redacted.pdf (14d), pen-exec-summary.pdf (30d), pen-triage.csv (30d), hsm-attestation.pdf (90d), witness-statement.pdf (30d). Manifest ID: eu-edge-1799999999.
Priya Nair: OK. Compliance nuance: EU marketplace can't receive PII; redact employee names/emails from pen-test notes. Also, some reviewers prefer screenshots of the mitigation verification steps (blur IPs).
compliance-ops: Copy: we'll redact PII and IPs. For HSM attestation, we need: device serial, public key fingerprint, certificate chain, and a statement signed by our crypto team that keys are generated in the HSM and never exported. Can we produce that?
Marco Diaz: Yes — hardware team can export public key fingerprint and cert chain. They will not export private keys. They also have the KMS attestation report from vendor (SafeVault v3).
Ben Lowe: Timeline? Marketplace wants inbound bundle in 3 business days. Who owns each artifact?
Priya Nair: Assign: Ben -> SOC2 redaction + one-page control mapping (due EOD tomorrow). Marco -> HSM attestation + cert chain (due in 24h). @evidence-bot -> generate presigned URLs and brief README for reviewers (due when uploads complete). compliance-ops -> review redactions and sign witness statement template (due EOD).
Marco Diaz: Noted. For HSM attestation we will include the following snippet in the attestation doc:
```
Device Serial: EF-4512-2026
Public Key (sha256): 9f:ab:34:...:e2
Certificate CN: redwood-inference-edge
Attestation: Keys generated in SafeVault HSM v3; private key material non-exportable.
```
Ben Lowe: For SOC2, I'll create a 1-page control summary focusing on: access control, change management, and encryption-at-rest. Will reference the SOC2 report but not attach full report.
Priya Nair: Pen test summary: only include high/critical findings + remediation status (open/mitigated/accepted) and verification steps. No exploit POC attachments.
compliance-ops: Also add a short legal attestation page saying bundle is provided under NDA and not for public distribution. Marketplace accepted NDAs in their intake form.
SI-contact: FYI, EdgeForge legal is available to co-sign witness statement. We'll coordinate their signature after Redwood signs.
evidence-bot: Upload instructions appended to manifest. Presigned TTLs: soc2-summary-redacted.pdf (14d), pen-exec-summary.pdf (14d), pen-triage.csv (14d), hsm-attestation.pdf (90d), witness-statement.pdf (30d). README: README-eu-edge.md generated.
Marco Diaz: Uploaded hsm-attestation.pdf to manifest (manifest eu-edge-1799999999). Attached cert chain and fingerprint.
Ben Lowe: Uploaded soc2-summary-redacted.pdf and pen-exec-summary.pdf (removed PII and POC). Added remediation-triage.csv with statuses.
compliance-ops: Reviewed redactions. Found one stray email in pen-exec-summary footnote — flagged and removed. Re-scan complete.
Priya Nair: Great. Next: witness statement needs two signatures (Redwood and EdgeForge). compliance-ops please route to legal for quick signature. Use e-sign (DocSign) and include witness contact.
compliance-ops: Routing now to legal and EdgeForge. DocSign envelope created: envelope-eu-1799999999.
Priya Nair: Final check: prepare short README for marketplace reviewer explaining included items, redaction rationale, and contact points for follow-up. Keep it one page.
evidence-bot: README-eu-edge.md uploaded to manifest. Manifest ready to share. Link TTLs as above.
Marco Diaz: Shared presign manifest link with EdgeForge and marketplace reviewer (private). Also included instructions for requesting a secure callback if reviewer needs in-person verification of HSM.
SI-contact: Marketplace replied: "Thanks. We'll review. May request live HSM attestation session if needed"
Priya Nair: If they request live HSM attestation, escalate to infra-sre and schedule time. For now, we met initial ask. Closing items: Ben (SOC2 summary) done, Marco (HSM) done, compliance-ops (witness) pending signature.
compliance-ops: Witness statement signed by Redwood legal. Waiting on EdgeForge signature.
SI-contact: EdgeForge signed. Marketplace reviewer notified.
Priya Nair: Thanks team. Capture notes for postmortem: tighten our standard bundle template for EU listings (include HSM attestation template, witness-statement template, README template). Will create a GH issue. :white_check_mark:
